correctness.evidence: Factorization and L2 estimate checked algebraically; rate threshold implies mean≥3δ³/4; periodic q=8,16,40,80,400 squares have claimed sides and no c≥1/16.

originality.evidence: Independent-parameter averages collapse to standard mean ergodic theorem/Cauchy–Schwarz; periodic overlap example is elementary, no distinct research contribution established against cited recurrence work.

scientific_value.evidence: Weak-mixing-uniform question untouched; conditional window needs input rate, and periodic controls do not address weak mixing.

limitations: Verdicts concern research novelty/value, not validity of the elementary calculations.
